reviews.title: Data is NOT up-to-date !!  Kmart is still listed :/ Oct 26
reviews.text:
Clearly has paid positive-reviewers.  Many locations on map no longer exist.... hence, near worthless.  Kmart went out of buisness over two years ago. One campground went out of buisness FIVE years ago.
The App works....the Data is garbage.

reviews.title: Paid for App, now they want a subscription.
reviews.text: They said paid members have the same features, but that’s not true. Now have to pay to see parking reports. You should refund us who supported you years ago. ***Update after response*** They claim all features remain but they changed descriptions/comments into parking reports, which you need to pay for. You cannot add these anymore. So their reply is not honest.

reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text:
Downloaded it to check it out. Noticed that campgrounds moved around on the map. I checked the area I live in and the Loves Travel Plaza and their scale moved location several times. Don’t know why, but not going to spend money on something not accurate. 

Received your reply and I stand by my review. The Cat scale moved from the I-70 272 mile marker where Love’s is, then moved to the I-70 281 mile marker.

reviews.title: I don't understand the 4.7 rating here...
reviews.text: The paid version of this must be great but the free version doesn't even let you search for a location?!  Useless for me and gotta uninstall and leave this review as a reminder to myself for next time lol.  Let me know if that "feature" changes!

reviews.title: I’ve used it for years, but updates have made it next to useless.
reviews.text: This used to be a great app to find WM, CB, etc. they updated but they threw out all the valuable info, and now have misleading AI summaries.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: This is literally the worst app I have ever tried to use to find campsites.

reviews.title: Buyer beware
reviews.text: Had the app for several years with full paid access to view reviews. They have since changed their business model and now want customers who already paid for it to pay again. No thanks. Shady company.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: This app used to be free. When it was free, it offered access to tons of offline information. Sites were visible to the user, especially campground locations. One needed to be online for any information other than location. Now that I’m paying no information other than minimal map features are available are

reviews.title: Click bait
reviews.text: You spent 15 minutes answering questions filling in information to get to the final page where it’s either gonna cost you $50 or $100 a month monthly fee quarterly fee a yearly fee.  absolute waste. It’ll tell you how tall the bridges are, but it won’t tell you where any campgrounds are.

reviews.title: Looks like it is good but…
reviews.text: This app looks to be pretty good, but I can’t upgrade to a subscription on the app.

reviews.title: So sad
reviews.text: The folks at all-stays camp&rv have managed to destroy what was once the best in class app. Sometimes the best improvements are to not let the new kid have his way before the changes are reviewed by someone who actually knows what they’re doing.

reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.text: It isn’t free to use after downloading, you have to subscribe & pay (you get 3 days free & that is it) to use it.

reviews.title: Paid App Removes Features
reviews.text: Paid $10 for this app years ago, now the features I paid for have been placed behind a paywall. Same thing has happened with Campendium and other RV apps so it shouldn’t be surprising, but they started out being free. It is extra frustrating when it is an app that you already paid for because you didn’t want a subscription.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: You have to find cancelation for subscription

reviews.title: What is that autio thing?
reviews.text:
Update: thanks for changing the icon for autio. Still annoyed with pop ups I have to get thru. 

I keep thinking it’s an rv park and it’s some story or something. I use the app a lot when I have weak signal and it takes forever to load so clicking on the “autio” is annoying., as are the pop ups I have to get thru in order to use the app. It’s no longer my go to app for rv parks.

reviews.title: Hard to use
reviews.text: Don’t like it but some how got a full year fee on it.

reviews.title: Incorrect Information
reviews.text: We tried to contact two different campgrounds using this app.  Both site had incorrect or outdated information.  We have canceled our subscription.

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text: App sucks. Advertised as free but only useful if you pay. This is fine but be honest up front that the app is useless you pay.

reviews.title: Not helpful
reviews.text: Well…I put a lot of hope into this app but unfortunately I have found more information on Google Maps or IA.

reviews.title: Default Auto-renewal
reviews.text: All stats makes it incredibly difficult to turn off auto-renewal. App refers user to Apple subscriptions but app sub is not listed. Very difficult to navigate app for charges and subscription management.

reviews.title: App sucks
reviews.text: Now that I’ve paid for this app when I open it map only, no rv parks show up.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: I’ve tried using this app many times but full of mistakes and nearly useless. I’d rather have my money back but I don’t think they’ll ever do that. I’m a full timer.

reviews.title: This app is now worth less.
reviews.text:
The Allstate app was marvelous and so easy to navigate. NOW it is a pain in the “A”.
Now find a State to explore is none existent.

reviews.title: New developer can’t be trusted
reviews.text: I originally bought this app for $9.95.  I have used it for years.  The new developer has asked continuously for people like me to upgrade.  Because we haven’t upgraded, now they have started to delete features that we previously used.  Not cool.

reviews.title: Stupid
reviews.text: Dumb

reviews.title: This app
reviews.text: Was very user friendly but with the new update I have cancelled my auto renewal and will switch to rv life

reviews.title: What happened! It use to be so easy to use
reviews.text: I have had this app for years. I haven’t used it much and today I was trying to use it and now I am required to have a password and sign up for a program. Very disheartening. I don’t need for you to track me ir send me advertisements. I just need to be able to find places to camp. I will be deleting the app. I don’t want to pay for advertisements being sent to my email or phone.

reviews.title: Avoid like the plague
reviews.text: Information is severely out of date. I tried using this app on a trip from Idaho to Maine. I gave up in South Dakota. Every listing was wrong. Some listings had been out of business for more than six years.

reviews.title: Used to be a great app
reviews.text: We travel 2,000+ miles annually. This app used to be my go-to tool for finding campsites, but recently, something changed. Now, the descriptions are sparse, and on some, the website link goes nowhere or to the wrong state. There is NO way I will pay for this app anymore.

reviews.title: What happened??
reviews.text: When I opened the app everything I needed was right there, campgrounds, truck stops, rest areas, Walmarts, Cracker Barrel’s, now nothing shows up when I open the app.  I’ve tried to set filters but still nothing shows up.  Very very bad plan to change this app so radically.  If it does not improve over the next few weeks you will lose me as a customer.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: You just had to go and screw up this app!  Update is definitely confusing and not as good as the old version

reviews.title: Refund scam
reviews.text: Used the trial subscription and it was ok, but when I missed to cancel the trial due to not having service, they charged me for a $53 for full year and then refused to provide a refund. Very unpleased

reviews.title: Not up to date
reviews.text: I like the Allstays app.  Most camp spots are still open and close to descriptions.  I find it annoying that the reviews are way out of date most of the time.  Most are from 4-10+ years ago.  Going to checkout more camping apps.

reviews.title: Charged me when I canceled
reviews.text: I received a charge to renew. I canceled this months ago but still was charged. The instructions tell me to go to settings to see my subscription. I did that and there is no subscription listed. Which is why I thought the cancellation went through. If you subscribe be careful about renewals.

reviews.title: Bad business
reviews.text: Purchased lifetime subscription years ago.   Apparently it has modified to the lifetime of my device, not me.  No way to restore to current devices.

reviews.title: Pay app so you can pay for a campsite. Lol
reviews.text: This app is truly worthless and charges you for the ability to get charged more for a campsite.  Nuts….

reviews.title: Locked Behind Paywall
reviews.text: Can’t do a single thing without a pop up to join premium and pay $$$

reviews.title: I’ve been dissed
reviews.text: I purchased this app years ago and now I’m being asked to purchase a subscription again! WTF!? I do love the app itself but I’m not paying for it again!

reviews.title: I BOUGHT this app
reviews.text: I BOUGHT this app before you started trying to make it all subscription. Why aren’t you honoring my purchase? It was not a cheap app.

reviews.title: Stay far far away
reviews.text: Once you sign up with this site you will constantly be deluged with upgrade solicitations. Have sent them emails asking them to stop but no luck. I will not be renewing. Only gave them one star because the system will not accept a no star review.

reviews.title: Tka
reviews.text: This is a scam. Easy to sign up but impossible to close your account.  No one ever answers the phone.  Don’t join!!!!

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text: For all the glowing reviews and allusions of it will help you plan your trip, it does little. I created a personalized filter, with stores and gas stations and low bridges, it only would show me overnight parking spots. It didn’t even show rv parks I knew were on the map. AND if you want to plan your route, it ports you over to a map app on your phone. Lots of money for nothing.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: After choosing destination it sends directions to a map outside the app - Google Maps Apple Maps maze(?) none of the filters transfer over I don’t want to go on a 3 day trip and still need to use another app to help me find gas stations, rest stops and other places to stay along the way! What a waste of money 🤬

reviews.title: Fraudulently charged
reviews.text: Though I downloaded a free version I am now fraudulently charged $49.99 for this application on my visa associated w Apple ID required for this Apple phone. I did not want the app ans nowhere did it disclose the amount but advertised free. This must be reversed now to fix the situation. I will not use this app or ever again anyone can find this simple information on Google maps or other sources.

reviews.title: Zero support regarding a double billing issue
reviews.text: I’ve scoured the web for email, phone and even this support contact several times over past several months without any kind of response. The phone # never answers or takes messages and the two emails I found fall into a big black hole. Good luck if you need any customer service - it does not exist!
